$description: Closed value set for plan.runtime_context — the platform capabilities the app declares it needs. Not derivable from app_shape/archetype/industry. Each value corresponds to a folder under backend/runtime/context_bundles/<name>/ with permissions + native imports + provider templates. Adding a new capability = new folder + append here. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-11-intelligent-rich-forge.md.

capabilities.geo: GPS + geocoding + reverse-geocoding; 'near me' queries; live location follow.
capabilities.camera: Photo + video capture; barcode / QR scan.
capabilities.push_notifications: Background delivery; badge counts; deep-link on tap.
capabilities.offline_sync: Local-first storage; conflict resolution; sync queue.
capabilities.background_tasks: Long uploads; workers that survive app-close.
capabilities.biometric_auth: Face ID / Touch ID / Android biometrics.
capabilities.wallet_pass: Apple Wallet / Google Pay pass issuance.
capabilities.deep_linking: Universal-link URL handlers; app-scheme; app-to-app share receive.
